title: Listening Drill — Observatory evening
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Observatory evening
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the hilltop observatory. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the lower gate. The visit itself will last seventy minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a torch.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the dome entrance. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: cover your light before entering the dome. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
